title: Emerging Regulated Verticals: Model Submarket Opportunity Thesis & Rapid Recon
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Objective: Produce a concise, evidence-backed thesis identifying 2–4 high-opportunity regulated verticals (finance, healthcare, legal, gov) where Redwood can gain measurable adoption advantage via targeted model compatibility, SLAs, and compliance tooling.

Scope: Rapid 3-week reconnaissance work focused on North America + EU. Research dimensions: market size and growth of AI-enabled workflows, compliance and data locality barriers, model feature requirements (privacy, hallucination tolerance, traceability), procurement cadence and buyer persona, incumbent stack patterns (on-prem, hybrid, cloud), cost elasticity and latency constraints.

Deliverables: 
- One-page thesis with top 3 vertical recommendations and clear rationale.
- 10-slide evidence deck for sales and GTM.
- Prioritized candidate model list per vertical with: must-have capabilities, likely vendor partners, quantization/hardware implications, and rough integration effort score.
- Tactical go-to-market starter checklist (compliance packaging, pilot KPIs, sample contract language asks).

Methodology: 
1) Desk research: public procurement records, vendor RFPs, regulatory sources (HIPAA, FINRA guidance, GDPR guidance), analyst reports.
2) 10 rapid interviews: 4 platform engineers/ML infra, 4 product/AI buyers, 2 solution sellers from partner channels.
3) Model capability mapping: evaluate 6 candidate open models for each vertical against a 12-point rubric (privacy controls, determinism, explanation tools, latency profile, embedding consistency, TOS/legal considerations, quantization tolerance).
4) Cost-latency simulation: run short token-cost simulations using representative prompts to identify likely per-transaction economics.

Success criteria: 
- Stakeholder alignment: PM, Sales, and Compliance sign-off on top vertical list.
- Actionability: At least 3 concrete pilot starter items that engineering can scope in a 2-week spike.
- Evidence: All claims backed by at least one primary source (interview or procurement doc) or two secondary sources.

Risks & Mitigations: 
- Risk: Vendor procurement lock-in obscures true model demand. Mitigation: prioritize buyer interviews and procurement doc review to surface constraints.
- Risk: Regulatory nuance varies by region. Mitigation: limit recommendations to NA/EU and flag region-specific caveats.
